why: The 8-K exhibit 'ManpowerGroup to Announce 3rd Quarter 2026 Earnings Results' sets the release for before the open on Thu 2026-10-15. Earnings Whispers' 10-19 row is wrong.
session_evidence: Company: results before market open 2026-10-15, webcast at 8:30 a.m. ET (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000871763/000119312526305399/man-ex99_1.htm)
where_to_look: Monthly staffing data published before the print: BLS temp help services employment for July to September 2026 and the ASA Staffing Index weekly series, for the US. Also the French (Prism'emploi / DARES interim) and Italian temp-work series, since France and Southern Europe are MAN's largest revenue blocks

Peers that already reported for the September quarter: Randstad, Adecco and Robert Half are not out yet, but check the monthly or quarterly commentary from Kelly, Recruit and Persol for September-quarter demand
Read the Q4 guide against Q3's: Q3 EPS was guided $0.96-1.06 at a 44% tax rate, with an FX headwind of 2 cents. FX moves since July (EUR/USD) mechanically shift the reported number
Progress on the transformation programme ($200m savings by 2028) and the Jefferson Wells disposal follow-through
already_in_the_wire: Q2 2026 beat (adj EPS $0.99 vs ~$0.95, revenue $4.9bn) and the return to GAAP profit; the stock rose 32% on the day
Q3 guide: EPS $0.96-1.06, organic days-adjusted constant-currency growth ~6% at the midpoint
Shares are -11.5% over 20 days going in
trades_on: The reported quarter against a low bar plus the demand narrative. Q2 2026's beat and return to profit took the stock up 32% (https://www.rttnews.com/3667730/manpowergroup-stock-surges-32-after-returning-to-q2-profit.aspx); April 2025's -19% and Jan 2026's +15% were guide-and-demand driven. Reactions are among the largest in the universe, median |6.5%|, implied 9.2%.
